breaks.window_reason: Before Aug 2023 the forecast ran ~13% above demand while in-area gas output doubled the same month: a change in what the series covers.

growth.note: 2026 runs through the data cut; its year effect uses the days available. TEP's 2022-2023 level straddles the Aug 2023 reporting change; SRP stops at Feb 2026 (coverage change).

net_load.note: Rooftop solar is behind the meter: measured load is already net of it.

breaks.window_reason: In Feb 2025 reported area demand stepped ~600 MW above the forecast overnight in one month and has stayed there, while APS's own retail sales rose only 1.5% in 2025: forecast and reported area demand diverge, cause unresolved. Scored through Jan 2025; later months reported separately.

breaks.window_reason: From Mar 2026 the forecast sits a flat 500-700 MW above reported demand in every hour, and weather-adjusted load drops the same year: reported demand stopped covering a block of load. Later months are excluded from forecast scoring and growth.
